title: 第2章
slug: 鍏堝氬悗鐖澶у彅鎴戞墠鎴愬勾
content_zh: 先婚后爱，大叔，我才成年司绵后悔了，早知道就不喝那么多酒了，现在好了吧，出大事了，竟然跟不熟悉的老男人发生了关系。白白的赔了清白之躯。司绵害怕的快哭了，早已没有了昨晚的胆大，她扁了扁嘴，“我怎么会走错房间了呢？肯定是你见色起意，把我拐进来的”脑海里的片段一晃，她记得她从洗手间灌了一瓶酒出来，路过这间房间的时候，被人不小心撞了一下，她跌了进来，迷迷糊糊的她以为她走对了房间。司绵缩在被子里，这跟她预计的完全不一样，泪在眼眶中打转，“呜呜呜…你趁火打劫…混蛋”被她控诉，顾墨有些烦躁，昨晚他给过她机会，是她要强行来的，怎么能说他趁火打劫。“小姐，拜托你搞清楚情况，是你闯进来对我献身的，我可没对你使手段”司绵一听，懊恼死了，喝酒误事吧，以后打死也不喝酒了。越想越郁闷，司绵的泪不停的往下掉。对于哄女人，顾墨一向没什么耐心，拿过旁边的纸扔到她的面前，皱眉的开口，“行了，别哭了，事情已经发生了，再哭也挽回不了什么了”年纪轻轻的，学人家喝那么多酒，出了这样的事情，只能怪她不够谨慎。“你是男人，力气比我大，你完全可以把我推开的，你为什么不推开，你这不叫趁火打劫是什么，总之我要告你，你这只披着人皮的禽|兽”司绵泪眼婆娑的开口。顾墨承认昨晚他的意志力有些动摇，要是他真一点感觉也没有，肯定能把她扔出去。导致这事发生，他也有错，但是这事不能让她知道。顾墨掏出卡递给她，“这样吧，这里有一张卡，里面有几万块钱，够你去医院做一个修复手术了”说实在的，今天他的耐心已经超过平常的极限的，要不是看在他也有错的份上，他早不想跟她废话了。直接甩手走人。司绵见他想用钱打发自己，顿时很生气，打掉他手中的卡。“哼，别以为我不知道你在想什么，我告诉你，我还未成年，跟未成年人发生关系，不管是自愿的还是被迫的，你都会被判刑的，你坐牢坐定了”她当然是吓他的，她肯定不是未成年，发生这样的乌龙事情，她比任何人都希望快点化小，最后化了，但是看不惯他的态度，给他一个教训。顾墨怒瞪着她，“这件事闹大了对你没好处，而且你不会有这个机会，我劝你还是拿钱走人比较好”她在去报警的途中就会被他拦下，他不会允许这样的丑闻爆出。他浑身充斥着一股子气势，让人不敢反抗。司绵咬着下唇，看他身上穿着的品位，应该不是小人物，算她倒霉吧，她只希望这件事情快点过去。“你还不快走，站在这里干什么？难不成你还真想背上诱|歼儿童的罪名啊”司绵不管这房间是谁开的，张口开始赶人。“卡留给你，随便你花不花，总之，以后不许赖上我”顾墨拿了一张纸，把密码写上，连同那张卡放在床头柜上。司绵被他的话气得不行，立刻反击，“谁稀罕赖着你啊，本小姐青春又可爱，我还怕你死缠着我不放呢，你给我滚远点，我再也不想看见你”这老男人趁机占了她的便宜，现在又一副嫌弃的样子，看着真是火大。
content_en: Marriage first, love later, uncle, I have only grown up. Si Mian regretted it. He would have stopped drinking so much if he had known better. Now he is fine. Something big happened. He actually had a relationship with an old man he was not familiar with. Losing your innocence in vain. Si Mian was so scared that she almost cried. She no longer had the courage she had last night. She pursed her lips and said, "How could I have walked into the wrong room? You must have lured me in because of your sexual desire." The fragments in her mind flashed, and she remembered that she drank a bottle of wine from the bathroom. When passing by this room, she was accidentally bumped by someone, and she fell in. She thought she was in the right room. Si Mian huddled under the quilt. This was completely different from what she expected. Tears welled up in her eyes, "Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" "Miss, please understand the situation. You broke in and devoted yourself to me. I didn't use any tricks on you." When Si Mian heard this, he was very upset. Drinking will make things worse. From now on, I won't drink anymore until I die. The more he thought about it, the more depressed he became, and Si Mian's tears kept falling. Gu Mo never had much patience when it came to coaxing women. He took the paper next to him and threw it in front of her. He frowned and said, "Okay, stop crying. What happened has already happened. You can't fix anything by crying anymore." She was young and drank so much like others. If something like this happened, she could only blame her for not being cautious enough. "You are a man, you are stronger than me. You can push me away. Why don't you push me away? You are taking advantage of the situation. Anyway, I am going to sue you, you are a beast in human skin." Si Mian said with tears in his eyes. Gu Mo admitted that his willpower was a little shaken last night. If he really didn't feel anything at all, he would definitely throw her out. He was also at fault for causing this to happen, but she couldn't let her know about it. Gu Mo took out the card and handed it to her, "Well, here is a card with tens of thousands of dollars in it, which is enough for you to go to the hospital for a repair surgery." To be honest, his patience has exceeded the usual limit today. If it weren't for the fact that he was also at fault, he would have stopped talking nonsense to her. Just throw away your hands and leave. When Si Mian saw that he wanted to spend money on himself, he immediately became angry and knocked the card out of his hand. "Humph, don't think that I don't know what you are thinking. Let me tell you, I am not yet a minor. If you have sex with a minor, whether it is voluntary or forced, you will be sentenced. You will go to jail." Of course she was scaring him. She was definitely not a minor. When such an oolong thing happened, she hoped to change her gender as soon as possible, and she finally did so, but she couldn't stand his attitude and taught him a lesson. Gu Mo glared at her angrily, "It won't be good for you if this matter gets bigger, and you won't have this chance. I advise you to take the money and leave." She would be stopped by him on the way to call the police. He would not allow such a scandal to break out. He was full of momentum, making people dare not resist. Si Mian bit her lower lip. Judging from the taste of what he was wearing, he was probably not a nobody. She was unlucky. She just hoped that this matter would pass quickly. "Why don't you leave quickly, why are you standing here? Do you really want to be charged with luring and annihilating children?" Si Mian opened his mouth and started to chase people away, regardless of who opened the room. "I'll leave the card to you, you can spend it or not. In short, don't rely on me in the future." Gu Mo took a piece of paper, wrote down the password, and put it on the bedside table along with the card. Si Mian was so angry at his words that he immediately counterattacked, "Who cares about relying on you? I am young and cute. I am afraid that you will cling to me. Get away from me. I don't want to see you again." The old man took the opportunity to take advantage of her, and now he looked disgusted. He looked really angry.
novel_title: 先婚后爱,大叔,我才成年
